cd D:\physics\sdft; python -c @'
import torch, transformers
from transformers import AutoConfig
for name in ["Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B", "Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B", "Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B"]:
    cfg = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(name)
    with torch.device("meta"):
        m = transformers.AutoModelForMultimodalLM.from_config(cfg)
    n = sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters())
    t = cfg.text_config
    print(f"{name}: total={n/1e9:.2f}B hidden={t.hidden_size} layers={t.num_hidden_layers} vocab={t.vocab_size}")
